description: UT1-UTC and polar motion of the IERS EOP 20 C04 series sampled at 12h UTC, against the gem interpolating the same series sampled at 0h UTC. Both files are the C04 2020 solution (readme, v4 of 2026-02-05). For x and y the 12h values are the primary ones from 1994: they are the ITRF2020 values from 1994 to 2020, and from 2021 to 2024 the 0h values are themselves interpolated from the 12h ones, so over that period the difference measures two interpolations against each other rather than one against the truth. UT1 has been Vondrak-smoothed since 1984. The cases are every 53th noon from the start of the 12h series, plus the noons on either side of each leap second. Each case carries the 0h values from 3 days before to 4 days after, enough for every method listed. Differences are gem minus C04 12h, in microseconds for UT1-UTC and microarcseconds for x and y.

c04_0h.title: EOP (IERS) 20 C04 TIME SERIES consistent with ITRF 2020 - sampled at 0h UTC
